shorts.topic: The Great Filter theory suggests advanced civilizations face existential barriers that prevent them from emerging or expanding beyond their home planet, explaining why we haven't found extraterrestrial life in the vast cosmos.

shorts.title: Is Glass Actually a Liquid? The Science Explained
shorts.topic: The popular misconception that glass is a very slow-moving liquid is false; glass is actually an amorphous solid, a state between a true solid and a liquid, giving it its unique properties without flowing.
shorts.hook: Despite what you've heard, ancient windows don't prove glass is slowly flowing; it's actually an amorphous solid.
